dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Slightly concave trailing edge exhibiting a low-magnitude inward curve from the posterior dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex characterized by an obtuse morphological point and a broad pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree linear incline relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the body.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Wide base-to-height ratio approximately measured at 1.8:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Shallow convex arc with a large radius relative to the total cranial length.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Proportionally short and thick beak structure with a low length-to-depth pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Wide obtuse interior angle located at the pixel transition where the melon slope meets the dorsal rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Monochromatic cyan/turquoise luminescence across the entire visible surface with distinct polygonal mesh artifacts and edge aliasing.
